fusions.name: Belly to the Sky
fusions.desc: Flips the target onto its back, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipped Across the Pond
fusions.desc: Skims a flat scute that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 70% chance to run off your shell and back to whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Bobbing Driftwood
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
